title: Text: DET Drew VerHagen ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: My bad, I forgot about this. Yeah, not throwing strikes didn’t help, but they’re still trotting █████████ out there. He can’t get big lg hitting out; you can. I would’ve chilled and let Andy work with you, but I don’t think the staff had that option
I hope someone good picks you up. If I were a contender with a 40-man spot, I would, but I’m prob biased lol
